goal: Build a password-protected admin dashboard for managing content and bookings.
summary: Phase 3 completed. Admin CMS is locale-aware and tested: admin routes moved to app/[locale]/admin/ with protected (dashboard) group and standalone login page; removed hardcoded /en/admin paths from lib/auth.ts and login form; AdminLoginForm now receives locale and validates callbackUrl to same-origin paths; added runtime tests for AdminDashboardLayout and middleware covering both English and Traditional Chinese locales. Build, lint, and 26 tests pass.
stepSummaries:
1. Create admin layout with auth guard redirecting non-admin users. Creates app/(admin)/layout.tsx and app/(admin)/page.tsx. [verified]
  2. Implement courses CRUD (list, create, edit, delete) using server actions and forms. Creates app/(admin)/courses/ and lib/actions/courses.ts. [verified]
  3. Implement blog posts CRUD. Creates app/(admin)/blog/ and lib/actions/blog.ts. [verified]
  4. Implement site content sections CRUD (hero, about, contact info). Creates app/(admin)/content/ and lib/actions/content.ts. [verified]
  5. Implement bookings management view (list, status update). Creates app/(admin)/bookings/ and lib/actions/bookings.ts. [verified]
evidence: Removed pages.signIn from lib/auth.ts; updated components/admin-login-form.tsx to accept locale prop and use /${locale}/admin default callbackUrl with same-origin validation; updated app/[locale]/admin/login/page.tsx to pass locale. Created tests/admin-auth.test.ts with 8 runtime tests for layout and middleware; existing tests/actions.test.ts has 18 CRUD/status tests. Verified: npm run lint exit 0; npm run test 26/26 pass; npm run build exit 0 with /[locale]/admin/* routes; zero hardcoded /en/admin in listed files; grep matches await AdminDashboardLayout and await middleware.
